hook_contract.configure: Keep pytest_configure callable, plugin registration name plato-profile-checks, qualify/base fields, _full_suite and Config/RNG fixtures unchanged. hook_contract.path_identity: Boundary is (config.rootpath / tests/llm_eval).resolve(). Parse arg before :: relative to invocation_params.dir; compare containment, not substring. Under --pyargs lexically recognize only tests.llm_eval and dot descendants. Do not implement custom Python module resolver.
hook_contract.preimport: Extend existing parent pytest_ignore_collect returning True only for unrequested optional boundary, otherwise None. Extend existing tryfirst wrapper pytest_collect_file to validate boundary/allowed selector/preflight flag BEFORE yielding; preserve native behavior and yield exactly once for allowed/nonoptional files. Consistency assertion in collection_modifyitems is additional, never sole protection. Inert package initializers are mandatory because find_spec may import parents before file hooks.
hook_contract.conflicts: Before session preflight, reject explicit llm_eval targets with base/mandatory/mlx-native, explicit native targets with llm-eval, any focused mixed native+eval target, and marker-only llm_eval without eval request. Named llm-eval rejects any effective -k, any -m, --deselect, --ignore, --ignore-glob and --pyargs, including addopts/environment injected options. Subset/core-only paths with named profile fail missing-ledger check rather than pass a small qualification.
hook_contract.sessionstart: For requested eval: execute bounded real prerequisite checks first, set eval_prerequisite_passed only on success; then preserve existing qualify and not base mandatory opacus/kazoo/gymnasium imports; named eval loads reviewed ledger. Focused optional-only requests do not become mandatory merely from directory identity. Existing native/retained order and diagnostics stay unchanged.
hook_contract.markers: Automatically mark by directory membership with llm_eval. Reject llm_eval marker outside directory. Do not give these tests runtime or retained_model_search markers; optional boundary governs scope and existing runtime partitions keep accepted meaning.
hook_contract.collection: On EVERY named llm-eval session compare actual full optional node Counter to independently reviewed cases.json: no missing, extra or duplicate nodes, regardless of full-suite detection or collect-only. Full roots retain unchanged core ledgers. Case IDs include exact parametrization strings.
hook_contract.outcomes: Extend strict checking to all optional collect/setup/call/teardown reports even when focused unqualified. Optional collection skips, skip/importorskip, strict/nonstrict xfail and xpass are violations; never grant base DP exemption inside optional directory. Full named execution requires every expected call pass and overall exit success including setup/teardown/interruption. Preserve original nonzero exits; policy can turn success into failure, never reverse failure.
hook_contract.summary: Report core scope (native and Lighteval excluded), existing native focused/complete state, Lighteval focused (not complete), successful collection-only (no execution claim), successful complete or failed qualification. No complete claim if ledger absent, collection-only or pytest status nonzero. Native383 exact ledger/content remain unchanged.

order: Import nltk and langdetect via actual environment imports and read installed distribution metadata. Do not inspect fake modules as proof.

Check exact required NLTK resources with nltk.data.find before importing lighteval.pipeline/task Registry, so upstream import cannot trigger a surprise resource download when missing. Missing resource raises scoped UsageError naming resource and provision command.

Import actual lighteval.pipeline and the model/task APIs the accepted real tests use; record actual module origin/distribution/version. No heavyweight model loading, inference or benchmark in preflight. Actual pipeline inference belongs to tests.
Any import/ABI/resource/API failure reports original cause with llm-eval prerequisite failed; no broad exception suppression or importorskip. No model/network fetch in collection/preflight.

Do not invent new package pins or mutate lock in profile implementation.
prerequisites.cpu: No Apple/CUDA/Metal requirement. Actual qualification runs CPU float32 tiny model with ACCELERATE_USE_CPU=true and CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty; no Config.device mutation in preflight. Existing Config behavior/fixtures remain authoritative.
prerequisites.no_fabricated_dependency: langdetect is an installed extra prerequisite even if chosen keyword IFEval fixture does not call language detection; no broader langdetect accuracy or multilingual benchmark claim. Resource preflight minimal to actual import chain, not every possible IFEval instruction.

missing_resource_negative_contract.scope: Test harness only, in fresh isolated children using actual installed NLTK and production profile preflight. No production-global search-path override or download monkeypatch is added.
setup: Create owned fixture root. For each required resource in turn, prepare verified real content for the OTHER required resource only; deliberately omit the target resource and any zip alternatives. Include a both-missing case if useful, but it cannot replace each single-missing case.

Start child using exact compatible llm_eval interpreter. Import real nltk; replace nltk.data.path[:] with [str(owned_fixture_root)] and clear NLTK data cache. Do not rely on NLTK_DATA alone and do not mock nltk.data.find.

Before invoking actual profile preflight, record effective paths and assert they equal the prepared root list. Assert actual nltk.data.find(omitted_lookup) raises LookupError; assert actual find(other_lookup) succeeds within fixture root. An absent-lookup assertion that fails invalidates the test fixture and must fail the test, not skip.

Invoke actual production preflight or pytest sessionstart via production hooks in the SAME child, preserving restricted data.path. Capture scoped missing-resource UsageError and original resource name/cause.

Install test-only import/download sentinels before this invocation; assert no import attempt of lighteval.pipeline/task Registry and no nltk.download/network callback. Do not manufacture the missing-resource exception in a fake function. Record actual outcome/order.

ci.placement: Add one scoped Lighteval CPU qualification step in existing required Python3.13 job after retained qualification and before typing. Separate fresh environment under runner.temp; keep existing base/mandatory/runtime/native/retained commands, timeout and gate counts. No all-extras, no SSL, no new matrix platform/version.
ci.provision: Use isolated NLTK_DATA path. A bounded explicit provisioning Python step downloads ONLY accepted punkt and punkt_tab via nltk.download(resource, download_dir=..., raise_on_error=True), or reuses a verified resource cache. Record exact resource/package IDs, resolved files and hashes, origin, package versions and cache hit/download. Network/resource failure is nonzero infrastructure failure, not skip or green profile. No download inside tests/preflight. Run provisioning with uv run --no-sync --python 3.13 python under persistent ci.env.UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT. NLTK_DATA prepends search paths; it does NOT prove other locations are absent. Record actual nltk.data.path and the resolved required resource paths. For CI provenance, verify provisioned resource paths are beneath the intended NLTK_DATA directory. Missing-resource negative tests must use the separate explicit child-path isolation contract below.

Then record source/lock/Python/uv and installed package list with that exact interpreter plus ledger/source hashes. Every remaining execution command below inherits that SAME step-level environment.

ci.limits: No dependency cap until root-approved metadata handoff. Maintain job110minute current limit unless measured final job data justifies bounded change. Optional extra means separate dependency/profile scope, not optional success: this CI step must fail the job on provision/test/artifact failure, with no continue-on-error or changed-path bypass.
ci.combined_local: One bounded combined collection and, where appropriate for final integration, combined execution using --group dev --group test-model-search --extra llm_eval validates additive core+eval contract. Prefer existing core accepted source proof plus focused affected guards over repeatedly rerunning whole core suite during author iteration.
ci.environment_scope: Set ci.env.UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT at the GitHub Actions Lighteval qualification STEP env level, not inline for sync. Every shell command in that step inherits the exact same isolated path: sync, package metadata, resource provision, preflight, collection, execution, artifact verification and dependency-present typing. If implementation splits these into steps, repeat the identical step-level UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT on EACH step, including steps that write/finalize optional evidence. Do not change the job-level core environment or rely on the prior command assignment persisting. Use uv run --no-sync --python 3.13 python (or the exact $UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/python) for all post-sync Python operations; never bare python for optional environment metadata/provision/verifier. Sync retains --extra llm_eval; no syncing uv run without that extra.
